display_information.description: Test console that detects raised hands in a Zoom meeting and signals a desk device.
display_information.long_description: Internal test app. Joins a meeting through the Meeting SDK for Web, reads participants' raised-hand status, and shows it to a person chairing a hybrid meeting. Runs only on localhost.

oauth_information.scope_description: Reads the signed-in user's name, and gets a ZAK or On Behalf Of token so the console can join the meeting for that user.
